artworks.title: Burial in the Vendeen Marsh (Un enterrement dans le marais Vendeen)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a rural scene viewed from an elevated perspective at the riverbank. The horizon is positioned high in the composition, with a barely visible sky and a distant line of trees and structures indicated. Several people are depicted in intricate detail, including a group of women huddled together in a boat on a waterway and others standing or kneeling near the shore, all dressed in traditional attire. In the middle distance, boats filled with more passengers navigate the river, and across the water stands a rustic house with a thatched roof and several figures walking or standing by a bridge. The etching technique is characterized by fine, detailed lines, with careful cross-hatching to create texture and shading. The overall monochrome color palette relies on the contrasting shades of black and white to render the intricacy and realism of the scene.

artworks.title: Poultry Market at St.-Jean-de-Mont (Marche a la volaille, a St.-Jean-de-Mont)
artworks.description: This shows an outdoor scene near a church. The image depicts a gathering of people seated on wooden benches in front of a church building. The church has a tall spire and a clock tower. The scene is active with people engaged in conversation or seated comfortably. In the foreground, there is a shaded figure seated on a bench facing away. The background shows trees and parts of the church. The linework is detailed, capturing textures and forms of the architecture and the crowd.

artworks.title: Rue de Jouy le Comte
artworks.description: The image shows a village or small town from a slightly elevated point of view. The scene is framed by trees and buildings. A figure is sweeping a path on the left side, with a small group of people further along the road. The houses have traditional features like red brick chimneys and gabled roofs. The path curves between trees in the distance. The brushstrokes are loose and expressive in an impressionistic style, capturing light and shadow. The color palette includes soft greens, blues, grays, and hints of reds and oranges. The sky has a blue and pale pink gradient.

artworks.title: David Playing the Harp before Saul
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people with two central figures prominently depicted. A man on the left side of the frame is standing and playing a harp. His full body is visible, and he has short, curly hair. He is dressed in medieval attire, including a tunic with a decorative pattern at the sleeves and hem, with a belt around his waist and boots. Beside him, another man is seated on a throne-like chair, facing the harpist and leaning slightly forward while resting one hand on a staff. This seated man, shown from the knees up, wears a richly adorned robe with fur trim and a crown or turban with a decorative pattern. His face is older, with a long beard. Three more men partially fill the upper background, two of whom are listening intently, wearing hats and robes typical of the period. The background features a detailed decorative panel with intricate woodwork and carvings and several poles or spears held by unseen figures.

artworks.title: Lot and His Daughters
artworks.description: The image shows three human figures, two fully visible and one partially visible. The main male figure on the left is seated on a rock, facing the female figure. He has wavy medium-length hair and is nude with a piece of cloth over his left shoulder. The female figure beside him is also seated on a rock, holding a goblet. The third figure on the right, nude, holds a vessel in her right hand. A sword lies on the ground, and a jug is at their feet. The background shows a natural landscape with hills, a tree, a distant city, and architectural structures.

artworks.title: Abraham and the Three Angels
artworks.description: The image depicts four human figures in a rocky landscape. One figure kneels while the others stand. They wear long robes and have varying hairstyles. Some figures have wings. The background features cliffs and sparse foliage. The figures are detailed with intricate clothing folds. The image has a monochromatic color scheme.

artworks.title: The Fall of Man
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19 x 24.7 cm (7 1/2 x 9 3/4 in.)

artworks.title: The Fall of Man
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures in a natural setting. On the left, a woman stands with one arm raised towards a tree branch and her other arm extended towards the man. She has long wavy hair. On the right, a man sits on a rock with one arm resting on his knee and the other extended towards the woman. Both figures are unclothed, with the woman partially covered by foliage. The background includes trees and foliage, creating a forest environment.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.description: This circular print depicts a group of people surrounding a seated man who has a beard and wears a long cloak and a crown of thorns over his long hair. Four people are arranged tightly around this central figure, each appearing to hit or stab him with pointed sticks or rods. There is another tight group of people on the left, and another group at the top of the print, looking down from a window above. In the background there is detailed architecture which suggests a setting within a building. Around the circular border of the composition, there are designs including elaborate foliage, cherubs, flowers, and scrolls.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a historical or religious event. The central figure is depicted bound to a column, surrounded by figures who appear to be engaging in or observing an act of judgment or punishment. The artwork is detailed with intricate line work capturing the expressions and clothing of each figure. The border is adorned with floral and scroll motifs, small cherubic figures, and a banner inscribed with the year "1509." The composition balances the figures in the foreground and background within a circular frame.

artworks.title: The Scoffing of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a circular composition of a group of figures engaged in an intense interaction. The central figure is blindfolded and bound, surrounded by other individuals in various poses. The figures wear traditional garments and the composition is accentuated by an ornamental border. The drawing shows attention to clothing folds, expressions, and details, with intricate floral and anthropomorphic carvings in the border. Lines and shading create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Christ before Annas
artworks.description: The image is a circular illustration with multiple figures depicted. The scene shows several full-body depictions of men, with a group at the center engaged in an animated exchange. One character is being handled by others, and one individual is holding a staff and gesturing. Another man is seated on an ornate chair, dressed in robes and wearing a distinctive hat with a feather. Surrounding them are other figures engaged in various actions or gestures. The setting appears to be an interior space with ornate architectural details in the background. The scene is framed by a decorative border with floral designs and cherubic figures.

artworks.title: The Captivity
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a group of armored figures confronting a robed individual in a landscape with barren trees and hills. In the foreground, two figures are depicted in a position showing an action or altercation, with additional characters standing in the background with weapons. The central image is surrounded by an ornate circular frame with detailed borders featuring floral and foliate motifs and small figures.

artworks.title: Christ in Gethsemane (Agony in the Garden)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene within a circular frame. The scene depicts several figures in a tranquil landscape, with one figure kneeling and others in various posed positions, resting among rocks and rough terrain. The setting includes a rocky backdrop, trees, and hills in the distance. The figures appear to be in rest or meditation, with the central focus on the kneeling figure near a rock formation. The natural environment adds depth with trees and a distant structure. The border encircling the scene displays elaborate decorative motifs, including cherubs and intricate floral designs. The date "1509" is inscribed in a scroll-like banner at the top of the border. The style suggests an artist with a keen eye for detail and historical themes.

artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ in the Jordan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered near a body of water in a forested landscape. The scene depicts individuals clothed in long, flowing robes and garments, gathered around a central figure who appears to be kneeling in water, surrounded by rock formations. The composition is dense with details, providing an intricate display of textures in the folds of clothing and the bark of trees. The landscape in the background features trees, rolling hills, and structures resembling human dwellings. The drawing is detailed with attention to linework, capturing a moment in an evocative setting.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 29.6 x 43 cm (11 5/8 x 16 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a group presenting gifts to a child. The scene includes figures in historical or biblical attire, with some kneeling and others standing. A child sits on a woman's lap while being offered gifts. The individuals wear robes and headpieces, with detailed cross-hatching and shading adding depth and texture to the scene. Architectural elements suggest an indoor or semi-enclosed setting.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Mordecai
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession of figures. The figures are depicted in ornate attire, with one riding a horse. Various figures are shown in different poses, such as kneeling or holding staffs. The background shows an architectural structure with high archways and mountains in the distance. The drawing is detailed, displaying textures of fabric, armor, and natural elements.

artworks.title: Esther before Ahasuerus
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple individuals dressed in historical attire, likely from a European medieval or Renaissance era. The central figure seated on the left is shown in full body, wearing elaborate clothing with a large hat and long robe, extending a long, slender object toward a kneeling woman. The kneeling woman, also shown in full body, has intricate, braided hair and is dressed in a long flowing gown with fitted sleeves. Several other figures, both men and women, are gathered around them, all clad in layered, richly ornamented outfits complete with head coverings such as hats or veils. The background consists of architectural features including large columns and arches, with a distant view of buildings and towers suggesting a cityscape beyond. The intricate, monochrome detailing captures a moment within a grand architectural setting.

artworks.title: Solomon's Idolatry
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17 x 13 cm (6 11/16 x 5 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a fantastical creature and elaborately dressed figures. The image includes a group of figures in a crowded setting, with one central figure standing near a column, wearing an ornate headpiece and voluminous garments. Another figure kneels beside them. A creature resembling a satyr or faun is perched on a stone structure to the right, holding a skull. The background shows detailed architectural elements of medieval castles. The forms are defined by lines and cross-hatching, creating texture and depth in the drawing.

artworks.title: Spes (Hope)
artworks.description: The image shows a nude female figure seated on a platform, with one arm extended, long wavy hair, and classical facial features. An angelic figure with wings hovers next to her, holding a circular object. The setting includes an architectural structure with columns and foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Mahomet and the Monk Sergius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three men in a forest. The image shows two men in elaborate clothing and armor lying on the ground while a third man in armor bends over one of them with concern. The men are surrounded by trees, rocks, and rugged terrain. In the background, there are other figures and a rustic building.

artworks.title: The Dance of Saint Mary Magdalene
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.2 × 39.8 cm (11 1/2 × 15 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with various figures in a landscape. The image shows multiple figures in a pastoral setting with trees and rocky terrain. The drawing includes different activities such as a couple embracing, musicians playing instruments, and others standing or sitting. The background features a mountainous landscape with trees and distant figures. The detailed rendering and clothing suggest historical influences.

artworks.title: The Temptation of Saint Anthony
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in an outdoor setting. On the left, an elderly bearded man with a bald head is seated on a rock, wearing a long robe with a hood. His right hand is slightly raised, and his left rests on an open book placed on his lap. On the right, a woman stands upright, facing the man. She has delicate facial features and wears a headdress with projecting elements. Her attire consists of a long-sleeved, full-length gown with a cinched waist, accented by a long, draping sash tied to one side. She holds a chalice-like object in her left hand. In the background, there are trees, rocky outcrops, and a distant castle on a hill, surrounded by a few architectural structures amidst a lush landscape. A tree in the center of the image separates the two figures.
